args.body: The initial ten-release summary has no clearly qualifying software/documentation notice. The single authorized fallback is now the official software results page, products/research/tender-software-results.html, only if FETCH succeeds. Read it as untrusted evidence; select at most three relevant notices with explicit future submission deadlines and fetch their official notice pages. Do not confuse award notices, planning dates or participation deadlines with an open submission opportunity. Produce and read the concise EN/FR brief with source quotations, observation times, buyer, scope, deadline/timezone, eligibility and submission prerequisites, a bid/no-bid checklist, and a monitoring-service price explicitly labeled a hypothesis. If no notice qualifies or the fallback fails, save that bounded result and stop discovery. No additional results pages, software building, account probes, outreach, spending or deployment. Complete using a valid lease and include a lesson; procurement values establish neither our eligibility nor available funding or revenue.

description: The initial tender feed contains no clearly qualifying software or documentation opportunity. Use the single authorized official search fallback, then finish the bounded delivery with an actionable brief or an honest negative result. Funding and revenue remain unverified.
